name: clipai-advisor
description: AI Assistant untuk Agensi Kliping - Full Stack RAG Application

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.test: cd backend && python -m pytest && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.lint: cd backend && flake8 app/ && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.format: cd backend && black app/ && cd ../frontend && npm run format
scripts.setup: cd backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm install
